name: 180-unknown-shape-is-a-stadium-too
why: A shape token neither side models gets the same conservative reading as a ratio-less roundrect: the stadium inscribed in the stated size, here radius 0.5 with a centreline from (-0.5, 0) to (0.5, 0). So (0.95, 0.45) is sqrt(0.45^2 + 0.45^2) = 0.636396mm from the centreline, 0.136396mm clear of the copper, exactly as in case 160 — while the 2.0x1.0 bounding rectangle would contain it. An unmodelled land must never manufacture copper it may not have.
